subject: english
question:
**Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**

The Special Task Force will conduct a thorough probe in the land scam case which has Mr. Lakhan Lal as the prime akused.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Akused**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

__
 
• The correct spelling of the word is "**Accused**" with double "**c**" and single "**s**".
 
• The incorrect spelling "**Akused**" has an extra "**k**" and a missing "**c**".
 
• **Accused **refers to a person who has been charged with or accused of a crime or wrongdoing. (उस व्यक्ति को संदर्भित करता है जिस पर किसी अपराध या गलत कार्य का आरोप लगाया गया है)
 
 
• **Example**: *The accused stood before the judge, awaiting trial for the alleged theft.*
 
 
 
• This is a spelling error and not a grammatical error.
 
• It is important to pay attention to spelling in written communication to avoid misunderstandings.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Scam **means a fraudulent scheme or deceptive practice designed to trick or deceive someone, often for financial gain. (किसी को बरगलाने या धोखा देने के लिए बनाई गई कपटपूर्ण योजना या भ्रामक प्रथा, अक्सर वित्तीय लाभ के लिए)
 
• **Prime **means the state of being at its best or the most important phase or period. (अपने सर्वोत्तम या सबसे महत्वपूर्ण चरण या अवधि में होने की अवस्था)
 
• **Thorough **means complete, comprehensive, or detailed, indicating careful attention to every detail. (पूर्ण, व्यापक, या विस्तृत, जो हर विवरण पर सावधानीपूर्वक ध्यान देने का संकेत देता है)
